meta.description: Fuel supply chains per plant: ordered nodes (mine or field -> rail -> loading port -> ship -> unloading port/berth -> conveyor or rail -> plant) with coordinates, per-leg geometry, share and sources; plus the water source. Tamil Nadu thermal, gas and nuclear plants are covered in full, plus a set of India's largest coal plants.
meta.schema: links[plant_id] = list of chains {id, from, mode, via[], share, share_basis, source, sources[], legs[{mode, from, to, geometry, geometry_precision, distance_km_approx}], path_nodes[], confidence, note}. plants[plant_id] = plant point + water + CEA daily mode/company codes + CEA FY2025-26 receipt shares. nodes[node_id] = {name, kind, lat, lon, loc_precision, sources}.
meta.share_semantics: share = fraction of the plant's coal receipts (by tonnage) in that chain's source category, from CEA monthly coal statements (FY2025-26 unless share_basis says otherwise). Where one category (e.g. CIL/MCL) splits across several chains (Talcher vs Ib Valley) share is null and share_group carries the category total.
meta.geometry: Rail legs are straight lines between real station nodes (OSM/Wikipedia coordinates), not traced track. Sea legs reuse ports.json approximate lanes. Conveyors and MGR are straight schematic lines. Every chain has 'estimate_geometry': true.
